|strategy=By Paul Evans<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/mindtricksdontworkonme.html</ref>

The one-turn beatdown has become a devastating maneuver used to decimate the Dark Side for years. Not any more with this card. With this card on the table, it sets up a safety blanket for the Dark Side, allowing them to leave a location a little thinner than they would like to, just the same as with a [[Ghhhk]]. Best of all, it is an Effect and cannot be denied use by the [[Frozen Assets]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] or [[Beggar]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] combos widely used in today's metagame.

Even better, this card can be used offensively by dropping an Enhanced character to take care of [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] or taking on the entire scout beatdown crew on [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] to remove Midge from play. Either way it is used, the tricks the Light Side has won't work on this card.
|rulings=* Cards that cannot be forfeited (such as a character not participating in battle, or a [[Floating Refinery]]) do not prevent a player from canceling all remaining battle damage.<ref name="scomp">Players Committee, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/Dark.json card data], entry <code>12_136</code>, <code>rulings</code> field. A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (15 October 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Cor-D-mindtricksdontworkonme-PC-Errata-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Mind Tricks Don't Work On Me (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): Same words as the previous version. The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels, with the mark “D-E1” in the lower border in place of the “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2024 D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
